mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at partly cloudy skies with a temperature of 77 degrees, feeling like 81 out by Badger Prairie County Park.

The City of Verona is hosting an I Voted sticker contest for students in grades K through 12. Designs must be submitted by July 22, and the community will vote on the top entries from July 28 through August 7. The winning designs will be printed on stickers for the November election.
There is plenty to do in our area today, including the Dane County Farmers Market and live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In our weekly look at police activity, on July 13, officers responded to a situation where a driver had become stuck on a rock. The incident resulted in an arrest for a first offense O-W-I.
You can grab a scoop of today's delicious Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough flavor until the shop closes at 10:30 tonight. If you miss it, tomorrow's flavor will be OREO Cookie Overload.
